name: WALLMAN
source:
Just a silly goofy game made over a few days based off of brain rot and a discord conversation.

You needed a place to stay.
You found a house.
You broke in.
You weren't alone...

[From [url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/wallman]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
只是一个愚蠢的游戏，基于大脑腐烂和不和谐的对话，花了几天时间制作而成。

你需要一个住的地方。
你找到了房子。
你闯入了。
你并不孤单…

[来自[url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/wallman]Itch.io[/url]]
